scientific_conclusion: Independently verified: The donor authentic Gauss-point damage on the crack center line reaches 0.99713, whereas unweighted element-to-node averaging in the receiver blurred the profile to 0.99285. Because g(d) = (1 - d)^2 + 1e-7, this 0.43% damage deficit causes a 6.16x increase in degraded stiffness across the wake, and doubles the total ligament compliance integral (1.981x). This artificial residual wake bonding transmits ~8.44 N of excess force, elevating Step 2 reaction force from 3.268 N to 11.709 N. A peak-preserving projection must restore the authentic Gauss-point crack-wake damage without artificially extending the crack tip or broadening the damaged zone.
